final_answer:
Let
\[
A_n=\int_{[0,1]^4}e^{-n(P^2+Q^2)}\,d\mathbf x,\qquad I_n(\lambda)=A_n\sinh\lambda+B_n.
\]
Since \(A_n>0\), \(I_n(\lambda)=0\) has the unique solution
\[
\lambda_n=\operatorname{arsinh}\!\left(-\frac{B_n}{A_n}\right).
\]

For a product \(P=x_1x_2\), its density on \((0,1)\) is \(-\log p\). Thus
\[
A_n=\left(\int_0^1 e^{-np^2}(-\log p)\,dp\right)^2.
\]
With \(u=\sqrt n\,p\),
\[
\int_0^1 e^{-np^2}(-\log p)\,dp
=\frac1{\sqrt n}\int_0^\infty e^{-u^2}\left(\frac12\log n-\log u\right)\,du+o(n^{-1/2}\log n),
\]
so
\[
A_n\sim \left(\frac{\sqrt\pi}{4}\frac{\log n}{\sqrt n}\right)^2
=\frac{\pi}{16}\frac{(\log n)^2}{n}.
\]

Now analyze \(B_n\). Write \(N=\sqrt n\), \(a=2^j\), \(b=2^k\), and set
\[
u=a n^{1/4}P,\qquad v=b n^{1/4}Q.
\]
Then
\[
4^j nP^2+4^k nQ^2+\frac1{2^{j+k}PQ}
=N\left(u^2+v^2+\frac1{uv}\right),
\]
and
\[
n^{1/4}(2^jP+2^kQ)-2^{3/4}=u+v-2^{3/4}.
\]
The logarithmic density factors become
\[
-\log P=\frac14\log n+j\log2-\log u,\qquad
-\log Q=\frac14\log n+k\log2-\log v.
\]
Summing over \(j,k\in\{0,1\}\),
\[
\sum_{j,k=0}^1(-1)^{j+k}
\left(\frac14\log n+j\log2-\log u\right)
\left(\frac14\log n+k\log2-\log v\right)
=(\log2)^2.
\]
Hence, up to exponentially smaller endpoint errors,
\[
B_n=\frac{(\log2)^2}{N}J_N,
\]
where
\[
J_N=\int_0^\infty\int_0^\infty
(u+v-2^{3/4})^3
\exp\!\left[-N\left(u^2+v^2+\frac1{uv}\right)\right]du\,dv.
\]

The phase
\[
\phi(u,v)=u^2+v^2+\frac1{uv}
\]
has its unique minimum at
\[
u=v=t=2^{-1/4},
\]
with
\[
\phi(t,t)=2\sqrt2.
\]
Also \(2t=2^{3/4}\), so the cubic factor vanishes to third order at the saddle.

Use coordinates
\[
u=t+\frac{x+y}{\sqrt2},\qquad v=t+\frac{x-y}{\sqrt2}.
\]
The quadratic part of \(\phi\) is
\[
4x^2+2y^2,
\]
and the cubic part is
\[
-\sqrt2\,t^{-5}x(x^2+y^2).
\]
Since
\[
(u+v-2^{3/4})^3=2\sqrt2\,x^3,
\]
the leading Gaussian cubic contribution vanishes by oddness, and the first nonzero term comes from the cubic phase correction. Therefore
\[
J_N\sim e^{-2\sqrt2 N}N^{-3}\cdot
4t^{-5}\int_{\mathbb R^2}x^4(x^2+y^2)e^{-4x^2-2y^2}\,dx\,dy.
\]
The Gaussian integral is
\[
\int_{\mathbb R^2}x^4(x^2+y^2)e^{-4x^2-2y^2}\,dx\,dy
=\frac{21\pi}{1024\sqrt2}.
\]
Since \(t^{-5}=2^{5/4}\),
\[
J_N\sim \frac{21\pi 2^{3/4}}{256}N^{-3}e^{-2\sqrt2 N}.
\]
Thus
\[
B_n\sim
(\log2)^2\frac{21\pi 2^{3/4}}{256}N^{-4}e^{-2\sqrt2 N}
=
(\log2)^2\frac{21\pi 2^{3/4}}{256}n^{-2}e^{-2\sqrt{2n}}.
\]

Therefore
\[
\lambda_n\sim-\frac{B_n}{A_n}
\sim
-\frac{21}{16}2^{3/4}(\log2)^2
\frac{e^{-2\sqrt{2n}}}{n(\log n)^2}.
\]

So the required constants are
\[
\boxed{\alpha=1,\qquad \beta=2,\qquad c=2\sqrt2,\qquad
L=-\frac{21}{16}2^{3/4}(\log2)^2.}
\]
